scope: Display existing phone file modification times correctly; do not change phone settings. User accepts not preserving source mtime on copy.

display_fix.process_timezone: Read-only copy of Mac /etc/localtime TZif rules, passed through process TZ only
display_fix.parser: Unqualified MTP timestamps use configured local timezone; Z and explicit +/-HHMM offsets use UTC conversion; fractional seconds accepted at existing second precision

write_timestamp_feasibility.send_object_info_historical_time: ignored for both UTC Z and local forms; phone assigned current time
write_timestamp_feasibility.android_edit: updated modification time to current time
write_timestamp_feasibility.decision: Do not pursue source-mtime preservation; no phone settings changed

remaining_display_limits: Unqualified timestamps cannot reveal device timezone. Mac/phone timezone mismatch still needs an explicit device timezone choice; phone DateTime MTP property returned DevicePropNotSupported (0x200a).
Finder creation date showed 2001-01-01 08:00; not solved or replaced with fabricated creation time.
Only Samsung Z Fold6 tested for actual phone display; UTC/offset/DST checked with independent parser vectors.
preexisting_setattr_limit: AFT still acknowledges ignored mtime setters; no writable-timestamp claim and no SetAttr behavior change in this display-only patch.
accepted_timezone_policy: User explicitly accepts Mac timezone for unqualified device timestamps. Keep explicit UTC/offset parsing; do not add phone timezone configuration or change phone settings.
